lockup.summary: The company, its directors, executive officers and existing shareholders cannot sell shares for 180 days after the prospectus date. After that, sales must follow Rule 144 limits or a registered offering.

what: It makes electrolytic copper foil, used mainly in lithium-ion batteries and electronic circuit boards.
proceeds: It plans to put about 45% into new factories and more production capacity. About 40% will go to research and development, and about 15% to general company needs.
risks: Its copper foil is used in electric vehicles and electronics, so weaker demand in those markets could cut its sales.
Past growth may not continue, and it may fail to keep customers, keep up with technology or stay profitable.
It faces strong competition from rivals that may have more money and may cut prices.
Its future depends on developing new products that customers may not adopt, even if they are launched.
